name: fx_a_newgame
doc: atb_vram after the attract demo: power-on, the title and the whole attract demo once (its last fight, the ice battle in 087, f9361-f9946; the title again at f10853), then B at f11301 -- the new game's Battle Mode prompt. The demo's fights leave their battle records in WRAM ($29B0-$2A92, the layer shadows $2C56-$2C59) exactly where a player who watched it before starting finds them; the suite's captures from the owner's own game (GATO, Guardia Forest) carry them.
